name: Keith Biddulph
biography: has been a tinkerer at heart from a very early age. Whether dealing with software or hardware, he has a passion for understanding how any gadget, program, or complicated system works from the ground up. Keith received his Bachelors degree in Computer Engineering at Oregon State University and works for a software company in Waterloo, Ontario.
